requirements.quote:
An UPDATE message may be received only in the Established state.
   Receiving an UPDATE message in any other state is an error.  When an
   UPDATE message is received, each field is checked for validity, as
   specified in Section 6.3.
requirements.condition: The BGP speaker receives an UPDATE message.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Accept an UPDATE message outside the Established state.
requirements.why_checkable: The UPDATE dispatch precondition can be checked against the current FSM state.

requirements.quote:
An UPDATE message may be received only in the Established state.
   Receiving an UPDATE message in any other state is an error.  When an
   UPDATE message is received, each field is checked for validity, as
   specified in Section 6.3.
requirements.condition: An UPDATE message is received in any state other than Established.
requirements.why_checkable: UPDATE reception in each non-Established state can be checked for an error path.

requirements.quote:
An UPDATE message may be received only in the Established state.
   Receiving an UPDATE message in any other state is an error.  When an
   UPDATE message is received, each field is checked for validity, as
   specified in Section 6.3.
requirements.required_behavior: Check every field for validity as specified in Section 6.3.
requirements.why_checkable: The UPDATE validation path can be inspected for coverage of every field.

requirements.quote:
If an optional non-transitive attribute is unrecognized, it is
   quietly ignored.  If an optional transitive attribute is
   unrecognized, the Partial bit (the third high-order bit) in the
   attribute flags octet is set to 1, and the attribute is retained for
   propagation to other BGP speakers.
requirements.condition: An optional non-transitive attribute is unrecognized.
requirements.why_checkable: An unknown optional non-transitive attribute can be supplied and its omission checked.

requirements.quote:
If an optional non-transitive attribute is unrecognized, it is
   quietly ignored.  If an optional transitive attribute is
   unrecognized, the Partial bit (the third high-order bit) in the
   attribute flags octet is set to 1, and the attribute is retained for
   propagation to other BGP speakers.
requirements.condition: An optional transitive attribute is unrecognized.
requirements.required_behavior: Set the Partial bit, the third high-order bit in the attribute flags octet, to 1.
requirements.why_checkable: The flags octet of the retained unknown transitive attribute can be inspected.

requirements.quote:
If an optional non-transitive attribute is unrecognized, it is
   quietly ignored.  If an optional transitive attribute is
   unrecognized, the Partial bit (the third high-order bit) in the
   attribute flags octet is set to 1, and the attribute is retained for
   propagation to other BGP speakers.
requirements.condition: An optional transitive attribute is unrecognized.
requirements.required_behavior: Retain the attribute for propagation to other BGP speakers.
requirements.why_checkable: The unknown optional transitive attribute can be tracked through stored and propagated route attributes.

requirements.quote:
If an optional attribute is recognized and has a valid value, then,
   depending on the type of the optional attribute, it is processed
   locally, retained, and updated, if necessary, for possible
   propagation to other BGP speakers.
requirements.condition: An optional attribute is recognized and has a valid value; processing depends on its type.
requirements.required_behavior: Process the attribute locally according to its type.
requirements.why_checkable: Recognized valid attributes can be checked for the local processing appropriate to their type.

requirements.condition: An optional attribute is recognized and has a valid value; retention depends on its type.
requirements.required_behavior: Retain the attribute according to its type for possible propagation to other BGP speakers.
requirements.why_checkable: Attribute retention after processing can be checked for recognized valid attribute types.

requirements.quote:
If an optional attribute is recognized and has a valid value, then,
   depending on the type of the optional attribute, it is processed
   locally, retained, and updated, if necessary, for possible

requirements.condition: An optional attribute is recognized and has a valid value, and updating is necessary for its type.
requirements.required_behavior: Update the attribute as necessary for possible propagation to other BGP speakers.
requirements.why_checkable: Type-specific update paths can be checked against retained values used for propagation.

requirements.quote:
If the UPDATE message contains a non-empty WITHDRAWN ROUTES field,
   the previously advertised routes, whose destinations (expressed as IP
   prefixes) are contained in this field, SHALL be removed from the
   Adj-RIB-In.  This BGP speaker SHALL run its Decision Process because
   the previously advertised route is no longer available for use.
requirements.condition: The UPDATE message contains a non-empty WITHDRAWN ROUTES field.
requirements.required_behavior: Remove from the Adj-RIB-In the previously advertised routes whose destination IP prefixes occur in the WITHDRAWN ROUTES field.
requirements.why_checkable: The Adj-RIB-In can be compared before and after withdrawal of specified prefixes.

requirements.quote:
If the UPDATE message contains a non-empty WITHDRAWN ROUTES field,
   the previously advertised routes, whose destinations (expressed as IP
   prefixes) are contained in this field, SHALL be removed from the
   Adj-RIB-In.  This BGP speaker SHALL run its Decision Process because
   the previously advertised route is no longer available for use.
requirements.condition: The UPDATE message contains a non-empty WITHDRAWN ROUTES field and a previously advertised route is no longer available for use.
requirements.why_checkable: Decision Process invocation can be observed after removal of a previously advertised route.

requirements.quote:
If the UPDATE message contains a feasible route, the Adj-RIB-In will
   be updated with this route as follows: if the NLRI of the new route
   is identical to the one the route currently has stored in the Adj-
   RIB-In, then the new route SHALL replace the older route in the Adj-
   RIB-In, thus implicitly withdrawing the older route from service.
   Otherwise, if the Adj-RIB-In has no route with NLRI identical to the
   new route, the new route SHALL be placed in the Adj-RIB-In.
requirements.condition: The UPDATE message contains a feasible route whose NLRI is identical to that of a route currently stored in the Adj-RIB-In.
requirements.required_behavior: Replace the older route in the Adj-RIB-In with the new route, implicitly withdrawing the older route from service.
requirements.why_checkable: Advertising a new feasible route for an existing NLRI permits checking replacement of the stored route.

requirements.quote:
If the UPDATE message contains a feasible route, the Adj-RIB-In will
   be updated with this route as follows: if the NLRI of the new route
   is identical to the one the route currently has stored in the Adj-
   RIB-In, then the new route SHALL replace the older route in the Adj-
   RIB-In, thus implicitly withdrawing the older route from service.
   Otherwise, if the Adj-RIB-In has no route with NLRI identical to the
   new route, the new route SHALL be placed in the Adj-RIB-In.
requirements.condition: The UPDATE message contains a feasible route and the Adj-RIB-In has no route with identical NLRI.
requirements.required_behavior: Place the new route in the Adj-RIB-In.
requirements.why_checkable: Advertising a feasible route with new NLRI permits checking insertion into the Adj-RIB-In.

requirements.quote:
Once the BGP speaker updates the Adj-RIB-In, the speaker SHALL run
   its Decision Process.
requirements.condition: The BGP speaker has updated the Adj-RIB-In.
requirements.required_behavior: Run the Decision Process after updating the Adj-RIB-In.
requirements.why_checkable: Decision Process invocation and its ordering relative to the Adj-RIB-In update can be observed.
